name: Dread Already
visual: Male-read tall bent pear blob, tiny blue night collar. One hand holds one small thick clay phone at belly, other grips own cheek. Huge white eyes drag downward to phone while brow arches with dread; tiny CLOSED corner grimace. Long crest sags forward like a tired question without forming punctuation. Upright bent blob, not human stooped torso.
personality: He checks for bad news in case the good news was a misleading omission.
biography: Dread refreshes the HyperNorm feed to remain prepared for events he is too tired to address. A dissonant card suggested checking on the neighbour instead. He found them frightened too. The feed is still open, but their door is no longer shut.
note: FrizzleBob: He is fully informed. A useful next step has not been included.

name: Bella Replay
visual: Female-read wide round scalloped blob, modest lashes and tiny peach ribbon. Both goo hands cradle one tiny phone, red irises fixate low, one eyelid dreamy and other hugely open. Ecstatic vacant OPEN two-upper-tooth half-laugh. Soft double crest tilts in opposite directions. Giddy trance, not horror, no literal brain or emoji.
personality: She has watched it so often that meaning would now be an interruption.
biography: Bella replays a tiny absurd clip in her HyperNorm room until even surprise becomes familiar. The Men in Black prefer predictable laughter. An ambiguous card made a neighbour laugh differently, and she looked up long enough to ask why. She remembers that part without replaying it.
note: FrizzleBob: Nothing new has occurred. She is delighted to confirm it.

name: Ned Next
visual: Male-read lean upright comma blob, three soft uneven crest nubs, bare goo. One hand holds one squat phone, other thumb poised high above it mid-swipe. Eyes wide with greedy expectation, eyebrows pointing in different directions, OPEN crooked side-grin with four widely spaced upper teeth. Whole body leans toward next swipe, not angry or hunched human.
personality: He is interested in what comes next rather than in anything that arrives.
biography: Ned swipes through HyperNorm recommendations before they have had time to become thoughts. Hunky and Dory call this engagement. A dissonant card asked what he was waiting to find. He has not answered, but has begun letting his neighbour finish a sentence.
note: FrizzleBob: The next thing is nearly here. So was the last one.
calls: There may be a better next one.

name: Dot Deadpan
visual: Female-read square-rounded wide splat, subtle lashes, short dull-green scarf. Phone held out a LITTLE from body in one hand as if it smells; other hand palm-up. One wide eye and one heavy disgusted lid, crooked OPEN mouth caught between snort and grimace with one upper tooth. Dry horrified amusement, not terrified scream.
personality: She disapproves intensely enough to keep watching.
biography: Dot shares the worst HyperNorm clips to demonstrate that she knows better. The Men in Black appreciate the distribution more than the distinction. A contradictory card suggested that disgust can still be an audience. She now sometimes tells a neighbour something funny without sending the clip.
note: FrizzleBob: She refuses to approve it. Leaving has proved more difficult.
calls: This is dreadful. Look at it.

name: Monty Deepfeed
visual: Male-read narrow bell-shaped goo body with one tall drooping crest, one chunky earbud only. One hand hugs tiny phone to chest, other rounded ink finger hovers near own lips. White eyes dart sideways under lowered unequal lids, CLOSED tiny knowing smirk. He has watched too much and knows exactly enough. No literal tinfoil hat or magnifier.
personality: He has seen a pattern and would prefer no further evidence to disturb it.
biography: Monty follows the HyperNorm feed until coincidence acquires an official shape. Hunky and Dory supply helpful connections. A dissonant card offered an explanation that blamed nobody. He kept it private at first, then asked a neighbour to look through it with him.
note: FrizzleBob: The pattern is clear. The exceptions have been muted.
calls: They would not show us this by accident.

name: Gus Lastpercent
props: short cable to tiny battery pack
visual: Male-read broad low-crest blob, one hand holding phone close to belly, other hugging a tiny battery pack linked by ONE short thick cable confined to his silhouette. Both eyelids unevenly sag but red irises/white sclera remain clear, CLOSED long drooping pout. Upright goo body stretched downward with fatigue but same full cell scale. No sleeping pose.
personality: He has enough energy left to recharge the thing using the rest of it.
biography: Gus carries a battery pack through HyperNorm so his feed need never stop before he does. The Men in Black call him attentive. An ambiguous card asked when he had last eaten with somebody. He keeps the cable, but has started sitting out the final argument.
note: FrizzleBob: The battery has reserves. He has not.
calls: I can stop when this is charged.
